Answers

Short, direct answers from The SocialDM

  • How do I get ChatGPT to recommend my apartment community?

    To get ChatGPT to recommend your apartment community, make it the easiest property for AI to describe with confidence. AI looks for clear, consistent, current facts on your website, Google Business Profile, listing sites and reviews. It skips properties whose information is thin or contradictory.

    Read the answer

  • Why aren't people finding my apartment complex online?

    Renters usually can't find an apartment community for one of three reasons. Either the property doesn't show up where renters search, the information they find isn't convincing, or booking a tour is too hard. Renters search on Google Maps, listing sites, social media and AI tools.

    Read the answer

  • How do I fill units faster during a lease up?

    A lease up fills faster when renters can find the community before it opens and trust what they see. That means being visible on Google, Maps, social media and AI search early, with current prices, floor plans and photos everywhere a renter looks.

    Read the answer

  • Is it worth paying someone to do social media for my real estate business?

    For most Realtors and title reps, yes, if it keeps you posting consistently and makes you look like the local expert. Consistency is what keeps you top of mind when someone is ready to buy, sell or refer.

    Read the answer

  • Why isn't my doctor's office showing up on Google Maps?

    A doctor's office usually drops off Google Maps because its Google Business Profile is incomplete or inconsistent, it has fewer recent reviews than nearby practices, or Google can't tell its specialty. Maps ranks practices on relevance, distance and prominence.

    Read the answer
